body:
> Regarding the cssClass, I'm not even sure the label wrapping the checkbox will be the final default template. Also, we won't even use this widget in the instant search, so I think we can just keep it like it is for now.

100% agree to review the PR as it now because it's sufficient.

> I listen to the checkbox change event, so allowing for a custom template would raise again all the questions of how we will be able to correctly bind our event if we don't know what the template will compile too.

For this issue I thought we did solve it in the refinementList where you can have either a checkbox or  a link and we only listen for the item click event (and it bubbles from the checkbox or the link to the item element).

BUT no need to make anymore modifications on this one, just wanted your input on the onClick/template
